title: Brava Security Emerges From Stealth With $15 Million in Funding
description: Brava Security is a cybersecurity startup that has emerged from stealth mode with $15 million in funding. The company offers an AI-powered platform that simulates attacker behavior to generate telemetry resembling real attacks, helping organizations identify gaps in their security defenses. The platform integrates with existing security infrastructure without requiring changes and provides insights quickly after onboarding. This solution aims to improve detection capabilities by modeling how attacks would appear in specific environments, thereby enhancing the effectiveness of security monitoring tools.
